variant.title: Disjoint Groups Sudoku
variant.description: Cells in the same relative position across the nine boxes cannot repeat.
rule.disjoint_group_repeat: Digits cannot repeat within a disjoint group.
rule_guide.title: Disjoint Groups Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The nine cells in the same relative position across the nine boxes form a group.
rule_guide.item_3: Each group must contain the digits 1 through 9 without repetition.
